hypotheses.persona: Active remote worker with morning fitness routine

hypotheses.persona: Standard office worker with early gym habit
hypotheses.rationale: Still possible if the resident works from home on weekends, but the complete absence of work devices (laptop) on both weekend days makes this significantly less likely than the remote hypothesis.
Contradicted by consistent early morning activity (05:00-08:00) across all observed days, including the weekend.
